statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
